persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrī jayabhūpatīndramalladevasana bhairavayā devaladāṅāyā dharota dayakā

notes: The colophon note on exp. 558b records an act of making/consecrating a dharota for the temple of Bhairava by King Jayabhūpatīndra Malla of Bhaktapur. No date is recorded in the excerpt.
